name: context_adherence_benchmark
description: A benchmark that measures how well language models adhere to provided context, instructions, and constraints (i.e., avoid adding unsupported or contradictory information). It evaluates models on their fidelity to context across prompt manipulations and adversarial context shifts. Tasks emphasize detection of context violations and generation that remains within specified boundaries.
reputation: A recent, specialized benchmark aimed at measuring model alignment and context fidelity with modest community visibility to date.
